download_diffq_build_artifact: download the latest GitHub Actions build artifact zip from facebookresearch/diffq repository
query_github_actions_artifacts: query the GitHub API to list artifacts for the facebookresearch/diffq repository
create_dist_directory: create a dist directory for storing downloaded build artifacts
stream_download_zip: stream download a zip file from a URL and save it to disk in chunks
read_github_token: read a GitHub personal access token from misc/token.txt for API authentication
